item.title: Convergence Roadmap
item.dc:creator: Convergence Finance
item.content:encoded:
We are now announcing the updated Convergence roadmap following the transformation to a new narrative AI-Enabled Trading Algorithm Platform.

2024

Q3 (July-September): Rebranding and Korean Market Expansion

- Rebranding: Upgrade the logo and website.

- AI Trading Platform Prototype: Develop the initial product prototype.

- Marketing Campaign: Launch marketing and operational activities to promote the new AI-driven trading narrative of Convergence.

- Korean Market Expansion: Focus on expanding Convergence’s presence in the Korean market and establish strategic partnerships with leading Korean projects.

Q4 (October-December): Trading DAO and AI Algorithm Testing

- Trading DAO Organization: Incentivize contributors through participation and contribution of trading teams; integrate team strategies.

- Trading DAO Governance Token: Introduce governance tokens to enable decentralized decision-making.

- AI Trading Algorithm Development: Build AI trading algorithm models.

- System Development: Begin system development of the platform.

2025

Q1 (January-March): AI Integration and Platform Beta Testing

- AI Algorithm Optimization: Test and improve AI-driven algorithms for better prediction accuracy and execution efficiency.

- User Interface Redesign: Launch a more intuitive and user-friendly interface.

- Data Analysis Enhancement: Strengthen data analysis and monitoring tools for more accurate market insights.

- Real-Time Market Analysis Tools: Introduce advanced AI-powered market analysis tools.

Q2 (April-June): Security and Confidentiality Enhancement

- Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE): Integrate FHE technology to secure trading bot code and strategy execution.

- Secure Data Storage: Upgrade data storage solutions for enhanced protection.

- Strategy Confidentiality: Strengthen measures to protect proprietary strategies, encouraging experts to contribute without fear of leaks.

Q3 (July-September): Global Expansion and Strategic Partnerships

- Global Market Expansion: Focus on expanding Convergence’s global presence.

- Strategic Alliances: Form partnerships with key industry players to enhance platform capabilities.

- User Education and Support: Provide comprehensive educational resources to help users maximize platform benefits.

Q4 (October-December): Ongoing Enhancements

- Algorithm Updates: Regularly update and optimize AI algorithms to adapt to market changes.

- Expanded Trading Options: Increase supported assets to meet diverse trading needs.

- Smart Trading Tools: Develop tools like smart stop-loss and profit protection for improved trading efficiency and risk management.

- New Technology Integration: Incorporate new technologies like blockchain and smart contracts to enhance platform security and transparency.

About Convergence:

Convergence is an AI-enabled trading algorithm platform that leverages advanced AI to revolutionize trading algorithms. It provides a seamless and secure solution for traders looking to maximize profitability while safeguarding proprietary strategies.

item.title: Revolutionizing Trading with Convergence ：AI-Enabled Trading Algorithm Platform
item.dc:creator: Convergence Finance
item.content:encoded:
We are thrilled to announce：Convergence has transformed from its original synthetic asset management platform to a new narrative AI-Enabled Trading Algorithm Platform.

To better align with the transformation and development of Convergence in a new narrative, we have rebranded the project, upgraded to a new logo, and launched a brand-new website: https://conv.finance/

Introduction:

In the realm of trading, the ability to buy low and sell high is essential, yet navigating the complexities of the market presents significant challenges. Convergence emerges as a game-changer, harnessing the power of advanced AI to transform trading algorithms and provide traders with a secure and seamless solution to optimize profitability while safeguarding proprietary strategies.

Challenges in Trading:

  1. Entry and Exit Points: Identifying the most advantageous moments to enter and exit trades.
  2. Volume Decisions: Determining the optimal trade volumes at each point.
  3. AI Integration: Integrating AI into trading environments without compromising security or efficiency.

Capabilities of Convergence:

  1. Algorithm Security: Proprietary algorithms operate within a secure black-box environment, preserving the integrity of traders’ strategies.
  2. Dynamic Strategy Updates: Constant adaptation to evolving market conditions to ensure continued effectiveness.
  3. Real-Time Feedback: AI delivers swift responses to market changes, enhancing decision-making processes.

Key Challenges Addressed:

  1. Tool Limitations: Existing market tools lack sophistication in guiding trading decisions.
  2. Strategy Confidentiality: Expert traders are hesitant to share high-performance algorithms to maintain a competitive edge.
  3. Retail Demand: Retail investors seek low-risk, high-return options but face limited choices.

Proposed Solution:

  1. Advanced Algorithms: Convergence incorporates cutting-edge trading algorithms for superior performance.
  2. AI-Driven Optimization: AI fine-tunes trading algorithms to maximize profitability.
  3. Secure Execution: Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) technology ensures the confidentiality of trading bot code, preventing leaks.
  4. User-Friendly Returns: Users can access optimized trading returns with just one click.

Trading Dao organization:

Since we transitioned to a Trading DAO organization, to further enhance the DAO structure, 10% of the reserve has been allocated to incentivize DAO members and reward core contributors who have made significant contributions. The original project management team, as core contributors and advisors, will continue to contribute to the project’s development.

Conclusion:

Convergence revolutionizes the trading landscape by merging state-of-the-art AI technology with robust security measures, offering traders unparalleled efficiency and profitability. By providing a secure and user-friendly platform, Convergence empowers traders to navigate the complexities of the market with confidence and ease.

item.title: Native cBridge Integrated to Convergence Finance
item.dc:creator: Convergence Finance
item.content:encoded:
GM Convergers! cBridge is now natively integrated to Convergence Finance. Check out our step-by-step guide to move your digital assets interchain (Ethereum Mainnet <> Moonbeam):

Step 1: Connect Your Wallet

1. Go to the Convergence Finance website: https://conv.finance.

2. Connect Your Wallet: Look for the option to connect your Web3 wallet. This is located on the top-right corner of the page.

3. Select the Network: Once your wallet is connected, select the ‘Moonbeam’ network from the network options.

Step 2: Access the Bridge Feature

1. Locate the Bridge Button: On the Convergence interface, find the ‘Bridge’ button. This is located in the bottom-left section of the page.

Step 3: Bridging Your Assets

1. Connect Your Wallet (if not already connected):Ensure your wallet is connected.

2. Select the chains: Choose the specific blockchain for your transfer: you have the option to move assets from the Moonbeam network to the Ethereum network, or vice versa, from Ethereum to Moonbeam.

3. Enter the Amount: Input the amount of tokens you wish to bridge. You can select ‘Max’ to bridge all available tokens.

4. Initiate the Transfer: Click on ‘Transfer’ to start the bridging process.

Voilà! That’s it, we hope that this integration improves your asset bridging experience.

item.title: Convergence Finance DAO is now Live!
item.dc:creator: Convergence Finance
item.content:encoded:
We are pleased to announce that ConvDAO is now live! The Decentralized Autonomous Organisation that empowers our community members to take part in shaping the future of Convergence Finance. This is an essential milestone to make Convergence absolutely decentralized in its governance.

Convergence Finance started out on Ethereum, and expanded to Moonbeam. Convergers have complete control over their digital assets without intermediaries. This is a massive milestone for Convergence Finance, as we believe in the power of decentralization. Our platform is designed to improve accessibility and popularize alternative investment to the blockchain economy. Convergence Finance is a platform that is inclusive, user-friendly, secure and transparent.

To access ConvDAO, simply go to convx.conv.finance, where you will see the VOTE tab on the left side of the page. Click on it, and you will see the ConvDAO page here https://snapshot.org/#/convergence finance.eth.

You will need to connect your wallet to see the governance proposals. For example, a current proposal is, “To upgrade ConvO subscription process (ConvO 2.0) on Moonbeam Network.” You might vote for, abstain, or against. Note that the more Convergence Tokens (CONV) you have, the more voting power you have to support or push forward a governance proposal. Every CONV holder can participate in the governance.

To sum up, ConvDAO is now live and operational. CONV holders can take part in the governance of Convergence Finance to shape the future development of the protocol. You are cordially invited to share your Convergence vision.

item.title: Convergence Finance X Biconomy Gasless Trading Competition with $15,000 in Prizes!
item.dc:creator: Convergence Finance
item.content:encoded:
Greetings Convergers, we are excited to announce our Trading Competition to celebrate our gasless integration with Biconomy. For a period of time, you can trade and compete on ConvX AMM on Moonbeam in a gasless environment made possible via the Convergence X Biconomy relayer.

Learn more about the Convergence X Biconomy relayer here

🏅 Click here for Competition Leaderboard 🏅
The leaderboard will be updated everyday at 8AM UTC

Note: Remember to check price impact before swapping!

Trading Competition Details

Competition Format

Convergers will compete as individuals.

How to join?

You MUST enter with this link, once you have completed all the steps you will be automatically enrolled to this competition. Failure to do so will result in disqualification. You may enter at any point before or during the competition, simply start trading on ConvX AMM on Moonbeam during the competition period to compete.

Scoring System

Trade eligible pairs during the competition to earn trading scores. Scores will be calculated according to activity and volume, where activity is the number of transactions and volume is USD equivalent of all transactions.

Eligible Trading Pairs:
• ceWETH/ceWBTC
• ceWETH/ceUSDT
• ceWETH/CONV
• CONV/ceUSDT
• ceUSDC/CONV
• ceUSDT/ceBUSD
• ceUSDT/ceUSDC

Activity — We will only count the first 20 swaps per day (resets everyday at 8AM UTC). However, you will still be able to trade in a gasless environment after 20 swaps. 1 swap = 100 points, max. 2000 points per day.

Volume — Total USD equivalent of transaction volume (first 20 swaps per day), USD value will be based on the value at the moment of swap. (Bonus points will be given to trading $CONV pairs, volume will be multiplied by 1.1x, routing via CONV will not count)

Score —Your score will be adjusted based on activity and volume according to this formula: Activity + 0.1 * Volume

Score = sum[Activity] + 0.1 * sum[Volume]
sum[Volume] = sum[CONV pair USD value] * 1.1 + sum[noCONV pair USD value]
sum[Activity] = 100 * number of swap

For example:
User swaps $100 in ceUSDT for $CONV, then the same user swaps $100 in ceWETH for $ceWBTC.

Activity = 200 points (100 * 2 swaps)
Volume = 210 (100USD equivalent * 1.1 + 100USD equivalent)
Score = 221 points (200 + 0.1 * 210)

Timeline

Competition Period: June 1 2022 8:00 AM to June 15 2022 8:00 AM (UTC)
  • Competition Time (June 1— June 15)
    Trade eligible pairs during the competition period to earn trading scores.
  • Score Tally (June 15 — June 16)
    Final scores will be calculated and tallied within 48 hours after the competition ends.
  • Results Announcement (June 17)
    Winners and steps to claim prizes will be announced!

Prizes

$15K USD worth of $CONV, split amongst Top 50 Convergers

1st place = $3,000 in CONV, ‘Analyst’ role on Discord
2nd place = $2,000 in CONV, ‘Analyst’ role on Discord
3rd place = $1,000 in CONV, ‘Analyst’ role on Discord
4-10th place = $500 in CONV ($3500)
11-20th place = $250 in CONV ($2500)
21-50th place = $100 in CONV ($3000)

Note: The L7D average $CONV closing price (9 June — 15 June) will be used to calculate the final $CONV rewards to be distributed.

Gasless Trading

Through this trading competition, Convergers will get a taste of gasless trading on Moonbeam. However, since the Convergence X Biconomy relayer is a separate contract, Convergers will need to have some GLMR ready to approve the token you wish to swap for.

The team will be extending gasless features for Convergers to not just trading but also ConvO subscriptions in the future!

Trading Flow

  1. Select a pair of assets you would like to swap on ConvX on Moonbeam Network
  2. Enter amount you would like to swap
  3. Click ‘Swap Now’
  4. Click ‘Confirm’ button to approve the token you are swapping with and pay gas in GLMR to interact with the Biconomy gasless trading relayer contract, you will only need to do this once for each token you are trying to swap. (If you have already approved the token, skip to step 5)
  5. Scroll to the sign message at the bottom, click the arrow next to the ‘Message’, then click ‘Sign’ button to continue the gasless swap.
  6. Voila, you have just completed a gasless transaction!

For example: If you wish to swap $ceUSDT for $CONV in a gasless environment, you will first need to approve $ceUSDT with GLMR as gas fees. If you wish to swap back $CONV for $ceUSDT, you will again need to approve $CONV with GLMR as gas fees. After this, you will enjoy gasless trading between these two assets without having to approve again.

item.title: Convergence Finance Product Spotlight and Roadmap — Q2 2022
item.dc:creator: Convergence Finance
item.content:encoded:
Convergence Finance Product Spotlight and Roadmap — Q2 2022

Hey Convergers! Hope everyone had a good Easter break. Last week, we set up the Convergence space on Snapshot and our first proposal was passed a few days ago. Riding on the DAO theme, we would like to share a quick update on what we have planned for the rest of Q2.

Convergence aims to democratize investment by making private markets public and enable cross-chain compatibility to maximize liquidity across different chains so users can transact beyond the Ethereum ERC20 standard. We have been focusing on Moonbeam deployment in Q1, launching the end-to-end product suite — ConvX, ConvPool, ConvO on Moonbeam Network for Convergers to enjoy the fast confirmation and low transaction costs. We have also offered LUNA private-sale tokens at a premium price (around 50% off market price) on Moonbeam Network.

Convergence Finance will be forming a DAO for Convergers to make many of the critical decisions that will define Convergence moving forward. Our future DAO council members will be chosen from nominations made by the community. To facilitate this event, we have introduced community roles in our Discord server for Convergers to leave their mark on the protocol.

Last week, we set up our ConvDAO space on Snapshot, a decentralized voting system that allows users to create proposals and vote in an off-chain and gasless manner. An improvement proposal CIP:1 To upgrade ConvO subscription process (ConvO 2.0) on Moonbeam Network was raised by the Convergence team and passed with 97.6% votes by the community.

Premium Convergers Program

Last quarter, we mentioned launching a new CONV holders premium membership program after Moonbeam deployment to reward users in addition to the current CONV rewards through staking pools. The launch is spilled over to Q2 as we want to launch a multi-chain friendly program now that $CONV is a multi-chain token.

Our initial idea is to share the protocol trading fees of ConvX with the Premium Convergers and the Premium Convergers will qualify for the highest premium tier in ConvO 2.0 to receive guaranteed subscription of our future private sales.

We will raise a preliminary proposal discussion in Discord for the Premium Convergers Program to refine the criteria before creating the proposal on Snapshot for voting, stay tuned!

ConvDAO and Asset Council Set Up

To prepare for ConvDAO and Asset Council, there will be a few key areas the Convergence Team would need to work on in Q2 before Convergence can fully go into a DAO -

  1. DAO structure
  2. Proposition creation, voting and execution process
  3. Council election
  4. Smart contract alterations and upgrade

We are aiming to launch the Asset Council in Q2 first so Convergers can vote on whether a project should be listed on ConvO for a decentralized listing decision, this would also allow Convergers to explore listing other exotic assets.

Biconomy Trading Competition

Convergence will be integrating with Biconomy to enable gasless transactions on Moonbeam for an exclusive period of time. In order to enable gasless transactions, our ConvX contracts will accept meta transactions which will be executed on behalf of users and their gas fee will be paid by Convergence X Biconomy Infrastructure.

A Trading Competition will be hosted soon to stimulate the gasless trading with rewards for the winners, more details to follow.

ConvO 2.0 Upgrade

With our first proposal CIP:1 To upgrade ConvO subscription process (ConvO 2.0) on Moonbeam Network passing, our engineering team will also be working on the new smart contracts for ConvO 2.0 to improve the current ConvO process with

  • “Deposit to Apply” lottery ticket subscription model
  • Anytime KYC application as long as user is not a citizen or resident of any of the restricted locations
  • Additional premium tiers with varying allocation size

We will be organizing another AMA soon so the community can share their feedback directly with our founding team. Stay tuned for our upcoming product updates and stay safe!

item.title: Convergence Finance Introduces Community Roles on Discord Server
item.dc:creator: Convergence Finance
item.content:encoded:
Convergence Finance will be forming a DAO for Convergers to make many of the critical decisions that will define Convergence moving forward. Our future DAO council members will be chosen from nominations made by the community. To facilitate this event, we are introducing community roles in our Discord server for you to leave your mark on the protocol. Find as many niches as possible to meaningfully contribute to the protocol and be rewarded for your contributions while becoming a stronger community together! No matter how you participate, the most important thing for the community is that you are active and present.

Hint: Our Discord server roles will help you run for our future DAO council!

Role Structure

We are introducing four community tracks for Convergers to participate and get involved with: Engagement, Trading, Documentation, and Development. Convergers may participate in more than one track, and receive rewards that come with roles you have achieved. Here are the ways you can get involved with the community:

Converger

Everyone starts as a Converger, contributing meaningfully to advance in the community.

Hearthstone

You may earn this special role by boosting the server to directly contribute to the heart of Convergence.

Engagement Track

Confluencer → Big Confluencer → Huge Confluencer

You may advance through the engagement track by engaging with the community, for example:

  • Helping out other community members by answering questions, providing necessary info, etc.
  • Sharing especially well made or funny memes and infographics in our #memes channel
  • Submitting animated logos, emojis etc. in our #emojis channel. Bonus points for outstanding work which will be accepted for official use on our server!
  • Make videos and/or create social media content for Convergence. Don’t forget to DM our admins with a link to your work.
  • Participate in events hosted in our #games channel

Trading Track

Analyst → Associate

  • Share quality TA content in our #trading channel, it does not have to be $CONV related!
  • Begin sharing original TA content to be considered for a promotion to Associate
  • Participate in TA/trading related events and competitions
We would like to emphasize the importance of consistency for roles in our Engagement and Trading tracks. You will not maintain your role and the rewards that go along with it if we find that you have been inactive or producing subpar content for a period of time.

Documentation Track

Scribe → Master Scribe

  • Create in-depth material related to the inner workings of the protocol that will be used as part of the official documentation of the protocol
  • Write a how-to tutorial in your own words
  • Write an article about Convergence
  • Find typos or grammatical errors on our official documentation
  • Start discussions and share your work in our #documentation channel and stay tuned for tasks posted in our #quests channel!

Development Track

Engineer → Senior Engineer

  • Earn this role by actively finding and testing for bugs
  • Contribute to feature improvements on GitHub commits
  • Show us your work in our #bug-bounty and #development channels, and look out for tasks posted in our #quests channel!

Rewards

Convergers can earn roles and rewards organically as well as through participating in events. Here are the basic framework for rewards:

For example:

Alice has received the most votes and won in the ‘badge design competition’, she will receive the ‘Confluencer’ role and $100 in CONV.
Bob has been consistently posting memes and helping out in the community for a period of time. Our moderator nominates Bob for the ‘Confluencer’ role and was accepted by Convergence team. Bob receives the ‘Confluencer’ role. One month later, Bob is nominated for the ‘Big Confluencer’ role by consistently engaging with the community and receives the ‘Big Confluencer’ role as well as $200 in CONV.
After earning the ‘Engineer’ role in a quest, Charlie has been consistently finding and testing for bugs for 2 months. Our moderators nominate Charlie for the ‘Senior Engineer’ role. After review, Charlie receives the ‘Senior Engineer’ role and is rewarded with a one-time $1000 in CONV.
Daisy is both ‘Huge Confluencer’ and ‘Associate’, she earns $100 per month from being a ‘Huge Confluencer’ as well as $100 per month as an ‘Associate’. After a month, Daisy has been producing subpar TA content and is demoted to ‘Analyst’. She will no longer earn $100 per month from being an ‘Associate’, but will continue to earn $100 per month from being a ‘Huge Confluencer’.
Eden is a ‘Confluencer’ and a ‘Scribe’, he will maintain these roles even if he is inactive for an extended period of time.

How it works

In addition to gaining roles through participating in events, our moderators will nominate you for a role if you have been active and contributing positively in our channels. If you feel like your efforts have gone unnoticed, feel free to DM any of our admins and we will gladly review your contributions.

Join our Discord server now and stay tuned for upcoming events!

Convergence Finance Kicked off $CONV Multi-Chain Token Utilities with Single-Sided Staking on Moonbeam

  • $CONV staking on Moonbeam is now live with 100%+ APR
  • Move your $CONV staking from Ethereum to Moonbeam to optimize transaction fees for staking and rewards claiming
  • Preview: Other multi-chain token utilities coming soon!

Hello Convergers! We are excited to kick off $CONV multi-chain token utilities with the single-sided staking pool on Moonbeam Network. While the Convergence Team is busy preparing for the other roadmap items to optimize the protocol’s cross-chain compatibility on Moonbeam Network, $CONV staking on Moonbeam is an important chapter to lay the foundation for $CONV’s growing multi-chain token utilities.

$CONV is now a multi-chain token on both Ethereum and Moonbeam Network! In our previous Moonbeam deployment for ConvX — Swap, Liquidity and Farm, the $CONV token contract has been deployed on Moonbeam and bridging of $CONV tokens is facilitated via our partnership with Celer Network by leveraging their Open Canonical Token Bridge standard and Celer Bridge.

Convergence (CONV) Token Contract Address on Moonbeam: 0x8006320739fC281da67Ee62eB9b4Ef8ADD5C903a

$CONV staking enhancements on Moonbeam

To improve the user experience on the Convergence DApp, we have made a few UI and technical enhancements of $CONV staking on Moonbeam Network.

$CONV single-sided staking has a standalone [Stake] tab on Moonbeam — this is to differentiate $CONV stakers from the liquidity providers (LPs) staking LP tokens to farm $CONV rewards on [Farm] tab.

$CONV staking on Moonbeam has the same vesting schedule on Ethereum, 4% of the rewards accruing every block are immediately harvestable while the remaining rewards are vested over 6-month and released linearly on a weekly basis.

If you are an existing Converger staking $CONV on Ethereum, we strongly encourage you to move your $CONV staking from Ethereum to Moonbeam as the transaction fees for rewards harvesting are minimized on Moonbeam.

Apart from the attractive* staking APR on Moonbeam, we have also upgraded the staking contract on Moonbeam to resolve the vesting glitch of the Ethereum contract. If you are affected by the vesting glitch of our staking contract on Ethereum, fill in this form here and the team will handle accordingly.

*The staking APR will decrease with the increasing staking amount when more users are staking $CONV

How to stake $CONV & earn $CONV on Moonbeam

Prerequisites -

  • Get GLMR ready as transaction fees
  • Bridge your $CONV from Ethereum to Moonbeam via Celer Bridge

You may also refer here for our previous guide on how to get started with Convergence on Moonbeam — get GLMR ready to pay transaction fees, add Moonbeam Network to your Metamask, bridge your assets from Ethereum Network to Moonbeam Network, swap, add liquidity and import tokens.

To get started with stake $CONV and earn $CONV -

  1. Go to https://convx.conv.finance/
  2. Connect your Metamask Wallet
  3. Switch to Moonbeam Network
  4. Click on [Stake] on the left hand side navigation bar
  5. Enter the $CONV token amount or choose “Max” directly then click [Stake]
  6. Approve on Metamask if you are staking $CONV for the first time and wait for network confirmation
  7. Confirm on Metamask to confirm the stake action and wait for network confirmation
  8. You will then see an updated “My CONV Staked” amount and start seeing your “Accrued Reward” grows

As mentioned above, $CONV staking rewards on Moonbeam are subject to the same vesting schedule on Ethereum — 4% of the rewards accruing every block are immediately harvestable while the remaining rewards are vested over 6-month and released linearly on a weekly basis.

While the farm rewards on Moonbeam are immediately harvestable to incentivize LPs.

Other $CONV multi-chain utilities — Coming soon!

With $CONV being a multi-chain token, the Convergence Team is working on a cross-chain friendly solution for the upcoming ConvO offering on Moonbeam to take into account Convergers’ multi-chain staking balance for premium pool eligibility. The multi-chain $CONV staking balance and $CONV-related LP token staking balance would also be counted towards Covergers’ voting power and eligibility of joining the Premium Convergers Program — more details to follow in the next few weeks!

About Convergence Finance

item.title: Convergence Finance Partners with Biconomy to Enable Gasless Transactions on Moonbeam
item.dc:creator: Convergence Finance
item.content:encoded:
• Convergence Finance is partnering with Biconomy to facilitate gas optimization and transaction management across the product suites on Moonbeam
  • Convergers are incentivized to trade on ConvX AMM on Moonbeam Network in the upcoming Trading Competition to earn rewards
  • Convergence will be covering the transaction fees via Biconomy’s multi-chain relayer protocol — to give Convergers a taste of seamless and gasless trading experience

To celebrate the start of spring and as a 2022 Q1 delicacy, we are delighted to collaborate with Biconomy, a next-gen multi-chain relayer protocol making Web 3.0 frictionless and mainstream by simplifying the complex mechanism of blockchain transactions.

Through the partnership with Biconomy, Convergers will get a taste of gasless trading on Moonbeam with a chance to earn additional $CONV rewards. The team would be extending gasless features for Convergers to not just trading but also the subscription on Convergence offering platform in the future!

Biconomy Relayer Protocol

Biconomy is a multi-chain relayer protocol that enables a simple blockchain transaction experience with their scalable relayer infrastructure. Biconomy’s Mexa uses the concept of meta transactions where the user is able to do a transaction on the blockchain with zero balance account and any third party can pay for the transaction fees for the user. Biconomy enables this at scale by providing a non-custodial and gas-efficient relayer infrastructure network.

Apart from Mexa, Biconomy also enables instant cross-chain transfers via Hyphen and paying gas in ERC20 tokens on Ethereum via Forward. Click here to learn more about Biconomy’s solutions.

Gasless Trading on Moonbeam

Convergence will be integrating with Biconomy to enable gasless transactions on Moonbeam for an exclusive period of time. In order to enable gasless transactions, our ConvX contracts will accept meta transactions which will be executed on behalf of users and their gas fee will be paid by Convergence X Biconomy Infrastructure.

In short, when you are initiating a swap transaction on ConvX, after confirming and signing the message which represent your meta transaction on your Metamask wallet (off-chain and gasless signing), this meta transaction instruction will be handled by Convergence X Biconomy relayer — without you paying the transaction fee.

Convergence will be funding your gasless experience by depositing GLMR into a Gas Tank to ensure Biconomy Relayer has enough GLMR to execute your transactions, all you need to do is to wait for your swap transaction to be confirmed on-chain.

We will be hosting a Trading Competition soon to stimulate the gasless trading with rewards for the winners, more details to follow.

Gasless Exploration for Premium Converger

Apart from gasless trading, Convergence will continue to explore and avail gasless transactions in our other product suites i.e. ConvO to further optimize the launchpad subscription process and maximize Convergers’ upside in future private sales. Let us know if you have any other awesome ideas that we should explore in our community channels!

Convergers, it is your shot to moon your portfolio! Stay tuned for the upcoming Trading Competition details.

Convergence Finance combines the edge of a lowered investment entry barrier with the liquidity, automation, and transparency features of DeFi to bring exclusive investment exposure to all DeFi users.

About Biconomy

Biconomy lays the groundwork for Web 3.0 infrastructure. With a user-friendly UX, users need not worry about multiple wallet management, and complex configurations behind the door. The two stakeholders in the network, executors and validators, implement and verify transactions on behalf of their users. Both parties are rewarded with $BICO tokens, thus providing a seamless, and quasi-gas free experience. Its mechanism is proven popular following the two blue-chip Metaverse projects, Decentraland ($MANA) and Sandbox ($SAND) partnership since late 2021. Moreover, Biconomy is backed by top-tiered industry investors including Binance, Coinbase Venture and Huobi Ventures.

item.title: Convergence Finance Launched Farm on Moonbeam and Introducing Dual-Yield Farm with Celer Network
item.dc:creator: Convergence Finance
item.content:encoded:
Hello Convergers! We are excited to share with you the launch of Dual-Yield Farm on Moonbeam, the first Ethereum-compatible smart contract parachain on Polkadot.

Convergence aims to democratize investment by making private markets public and enable cross-chain compatibility to maximize liquidity across different chains so users can transact beyond the Ethereum ERC20 standard.

Convergence’s expansion into Moonbeam Network after our standalone venture with Moonlit on Moonriver Network will facilitate Convergence’s cross-chain compatibility with the technical advantages and efficiency as a parachain on Polkadot and Kusama to enjoy the convenience of full Ethereum compatibility — the future is multi-chain.

Yield-Farming on Moonbeam Network is now supported and $CONV single-sided staking pool will be supported next, the team is also preparing for the next private-sale token offering on Moonbeam for a fast and low-gas token subscription experience. For the rest of our Q1 roadmap, you may refer here.

Farms on Moonbeam and Dual-Yield Farms with Celer Network

Farm aims to incentivize liquidity providers with attractive APR in $CONV tokens when they stake their Convergence LP tokens after injecting liquidity into the pools. This will in return stabilize the liquidity provision in the AMM pools and minimize slippage during token swaps.

Apart from the objective to allow users to swap with minimal slippage, Convergence Team would also like to grow the Moonbeam Ecosystem by introducing Dual-Yield Farms partnering with other Moonbeam projects that generate double-sided rewards in $CONV and the partner tokens.

In the initial Farm launch, to celebrate our partnership with Celer Network, Convergers will be incentivized with additional 3.3M CELR token rewards for an exclusive dual-yield farming experience on Moonbeam Network.

6 Base Farms and 2 Protocol Farms with attractive APR ranging from 300% —10,000%*-

Base Farms yielding $CELR + $CONV

  1. ceUSDT — ceUSDC
  2. GLMR — ceUSDT
  3. GLMR — ceUSDC
  4. ceBUSD — ceUSDT
  5. ceWETH — ceWBTC
  6. ceWETH — ceUSDT

Protocol Farms yielding $CONV

  1. CONV — ceUSDT
  2. CONV — ceWETH

*The APR will decrease with the increasing TVL in farm pools when more users are staking more LP tokens, please note that there is also a varying reward rate per farm so the APR calculation varies across different farms.

Act now and start farming $CONV & $CELR before everyone else!

How to Farm on Moonbeam

Prerequisites:

  • Get GLMR ready as transaction fees
  • Bridge your $CONV or other ERC20 assets from Ethereum to Moonbeam via Celer Bridge

To get started,

  1. Go to https://convx.conv.finance/
  2. Connect your Metamask Wallet
  3. Switch to Moonbeam Network
  4. Click on [Farm] on the left hand side navigation bar
  5. By default you will see “All” farms, you can select “Boost” or “Normal” farm tabs accordingly or even filter for your farms via the “Show my farms only” toggle
  6. “Boost” farms are farms with a higher reward weighting with a multiplier applied on the reward per block
  7. Click on the preferred farm to start staking your Convergence (Moonbeam) LP tokens
  8. You have to add liquidity for the corresponding pool to receive the LP tokens in order to stake in the corresponding farm
  9. Enter the LP tokens amount or choose “Max” directly then click [Stake]
  10. Approve on Metamask for the LP tokens that you are staking and wait for network confirmation
  11. Confirm on Metamask to confirm the stake action and wait for network confirmation
  12. You will then see an updated “My LP Staked” amount and start seeing your “Accrued Reward” grows

You may also refer here for our previous guide on how to get started with Convergence on Moonbeam — get GLMR ready to pay transaction fees, add Moonbeam Network to your Metamask, bridge your assets from Ethereum Network to Moonbeam Network, swap, add liquidity and import tokens.

That’s it for now, $CONV single-sided staking pool will come next and we will also be supporting ConvO on Moonbeam soon. The Convergence Team continues to work towards a cross-chain compatibility solution with the vision of enabling Convergers to freely move the assets from Ethereum to transact on a high transaction throughput and low gas fee network via our cross-chain bridging solution for the end-to-end private-sale token launchpad subscription, future tokens and other crypto tokens cross-chain swapping, liquidity mining and innovative yield farming to earn $CONV rewards.
